suetsuna_1998_hijiki.title: Separation and identification of angiotensin I-converting enzyme inhibitory peptides from peptic digest of Hizikia fusiformis protein
suetsuna_1998_hijiki.terms: Bibliographic record and numeric values only; no text or tables copied

peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text (J-STAGE, free, Japanese with English abstract): pepsin digest of protein from the brown alga Hizikia fusiformis (WoRMS: synonym of Sargassum fusiforme 494972), collected at Sasuna Bay, Tsushima, Nagasaki, February 1995 (p.862). Sequence by amino acid analysis, automated Edman degradation (477A) and FAB-MS (m/z 367, p.864). Peptide synthesized by Fmoc solid phase (433A, p.863). ACE from rabbit lung (Sigma) with 12.5 mM HHL (Peptide Institute), Yamamoto's modification of Lieberman's method (p.863). Table 1 (p.865, 'ACE inhibitory activity of synthetic peptides') and the abstract give IC50 3.92 uM.
Same paper and assay as GKY. FAB-MS m/z 368; Table 1 (p.865, synthetic peptide) and the abstract give IC50 8.12 uM.

Same paper and assay as GKY.
